baseline.name: Format digits, filter zeros and parse
baseline.approach: Convert the number to decimal text, collect nonzero digits, sum them and parse the filtered number.

why: Remainder/division extract digits, and a retained-digit multiplier assembles the filtered value without a text buffer.
quantitative_comparison: The archive avoids a d-character buffer while taking one loop per digit. Both approaches have linear digit-work; division costs versus conversion costs were not benchmarked.
tradeoffs: Uses fixed-width long long arithmetic and nonnegative-int input; it is not arbitrary precision. Since int digit count is bounded, practical storage savings are small and no speed advantage is established.
evidence_basis: Static auxiliary-storage comparison to a specified text-conversion baseline; no timing benchmark.
